en.s: The Battle of the Alta River was a battle that took place on 24 July 1019 between the troops of the Novgorodian prince Yaroslav "the Wise" Volodimerovich and the army of his brother, prince Sviatopolk I of Kiev, who was supported by the Pechenegs. It was part of the Kievan succession crisis of 1015–1019.

en.s: The Battle of Nocera or Scafati was the first major battle of Roger II of Sicily, and the first of his two major defeats, (the other being the Battle of Rignano) at the hands of Count Ranulf of Alife.

zh.s: 诺切拉战役又称斯卡法蒂战役，是西西里国王罗杰二世经历的第一场重大战役，也是他遭遇的两场重大败仗中的第一场。另一场败仗是里尼亚诺战役；两场战役中，罗杰二世均败于阿利费伯爵拉努尔夫。

en.s: The siege of Damascus took place between 24 and 28 July 1148 O.S. during the Second Crusade. Two Crusader armies from Europe and the army of the Crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem attempted to lay siege to the Seljuk Empire city of Damascus. The effort ended in a Crusader defeat.

en.s: The Scottish wars (1296–1357) were two extended military conflicts in which the Kingdom of England attempted to establish control over the Kingdom of Scotland. In spite of significant temporary successes, the English efforts in both wars ultimately failed due to Scottish resistance and Scotland remained an independent country. The wars were part of a great crisis for Scotland, and the period became one of the most defining times in its history.
en.n: Wars of Scottish Independence: Fall of Stirling Castle: King Edward I of England takes the stronghold using the War Wolf.

zh.s: 苏格兰战争（1296—1357年）是英格兰王国试图控制苏格兰王国的两场长期军事冲突。尽管英格兰一度取得重大胜利，但两场战争最终都因苏格兰抵抗而失败，苏格兰继续保持独立。这些战争是苏格兰经历的一场重大危机的一部分，这段时期也成为苏格兰历史上最具决定性的时期之一。
zh.n: 苏格兰独立战争：斯特灵城堡陷落，英格兰国王爱德华一世使用“战争之狼”攻下该据点。

en.s: After the Battle of Falkirk in 1298, it took Edward I six years to gain full control of Scotland. The last stronghold of resistance to English rule was Stirling Castle. Armed with twelve siege engines, the English laid siege to the castle in April 1304. For four months the castle was bombarded by lead balls (stripped from nearby church roofs), Greek fire, stone balls, and even some sort of gunpowder mixture.

zh.s: 1298年福尔柯克战役后，英格兰国王爱德华一世又用了六年才完全控制苏格兰。斯特灵城堡是反抗英国统治的最后一处据点。1304年4月，英军调来12台攻城器械围攻城堡。此后四个月，城堡持续遭到轰击，英军使用了铅弹（取自附近教堂屋顶）、希腊火、石弹，甚至某种火药混合物。

en.s: The Battle of Qara Darra was fought on 24 July 1336 between two rival Mongol factions competing for control of the Ilkhanate throne following the death of Abu Sa'id in 1335. The confrontation took place in the vicinity of Van and marked a key episode in the collapse of central Ilkhanid authority.

zh.s: 卡拉达拉战役于1336年7月24日爆发。阿布·赛义德于1335年去世后，两个蒙古派系为争夺伊儿汗国王位而交战。战斗发生在凡城附近，是伊儿汗国中央政权瓦解过程中的一个重要事件。

en.s: The Battle of Harlaw (Scottish Gaelic: Cath Gairbheach) was a Scottish clan battle fought on 24 July 1411 just north of Inverurie in Aberdeenshire. It was one of a series of battles fought during the Middle Ages between the barons of northeast Scotland against those from the west coast. The battle was fought to resolve competing claims to the Earldom of Ross, a large region of northern Scotland. Robert Stewart, Duke of Albany, Regent of Scotland, had taken control of the earldom as guardian of his niece Euphemia Leslie. This claim was contested by Donald, Lord of the Isles, who had married Euphemia's aunt Mariota.

zh.s: 哈洛战役（苏格兰盖尔语：Cath Gairbheach）于1411年7月24日在因弗鲁里以北不远处、阿伯丁郡境内爆发，是苏格兰氏族之间的一场战斗。它是中世纪苏格兰东北部与西海岸贵族之间一系列冲突之一，起因是各方争夺苏格兰北部大片地区罗斯伯爵领的归属。苏格兰摄政、奥尔巴尼公爵罗伯特·斯图尔特以侄女尤菲米娅·莱斯利的监护人身份控制了该伯爵领。与此主张相争的是群岛领主唐纳德；他娶了尤菲米娅的姑母玛丽奥塔。

en.s: The Sack of Kilwa (Portuguese: Saque de Quiloa) was a military campaign carried out by the Portuguese on 24 July 1505, led by Dom Francisco de Almeida, against the city-state of the Kilwa Sultanate. The operation resulted in a decisive Portuguese victory and the sacking of Kilwa, a prominent trading hub along the Swahili Coast. After sacking Kilwa, the Portuguese built Fort Santiago in the city before proceeding to attack Mombasa.

zh.s: 基尔瓦之劫（葡萄牙语：Saque de Quiloa）是葡萄牙人于1505年7月24日发动的一次军事行动，由弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔梅达率领，目标是基尔瓦苏丹国的城邦基尔瓦。葡萄牙人取得决定性胜利，并洗劫了这座斯瓦希里海岸的重要贸易中心。此后，葡萄牙人在城内修建圣地亚哥堡，随后继续进攻蒙巴萨。

en.s: The sack of Vieste was conducted by Dragut, an Ottoman naval commander. It took place on 15 July 1554. This sack resulted in the capture of the fortress, a massacre, and the enslavement of thousands. On 15 July 1554, Dragut landed in Vieste with 60 or 70 galleys. Upon his arrival, the inhabitants of Vieste took shelter between a cathedral and castle, which they had barricaded.

en.t: Mary, Queen of Scots, is forced to abdicate and be replaced by her one-year-old son James VI
en.s: Mary, Queen of Scots (8 December 1542 – 8 February 1587), also known as Mary Stuart or Mary I of Scotland, was Queen of Scotland from 14 December 1542 until her forced abdication on 24 July 1567. The only surviving legitimate child of King James V of Scotland, Mary was six days old when her father died, and she inherited the throne.

zh.t: 苏格兰女王玛丽被迫退位，王位由年仅一岁的儿子詹姆斯六世继承
zh.s: 苏格兰女王玛丽（1542年12月8日—1587年2月8日）又称玛丽·斯图亚特或苏格兰女王玛丽一世。1567年7月24日，她被迫退位。她是苏格兰国王詹姆斯五世唯一存活的婚生子女；父亲去世时她年仅六天大，随后继承王位。

en.s: The siege of Grol or Groenlo in 1595 was a siege of Groenlo by States forces under Maurice of Nassau during the Eighty Years' War in an attempt to capture it from the Spanish Empire. It lasted from 14 to 24 July 1595, ending with the arrival of a Spanish relief force under Cristóbal de Mondragón and Maurice's retreat.

The siege began on 17 July 1690, when Williamite Lieutenant-General James Douglas arrived outside the Jacobite held city of Athlone with ten regiments of foot and five regiments of horse for a total force of 12,000.

en.s: Antoine de la Mothe, sieur de Cadillac (, French: [kadijak]; March 5, 1658 – October 16, 1730), born Antoine Laumet, was a French explorer, military officer, colonial administrator in New France, and founder of Detroit, Michigan. Born in Gascony, Cadillac arrived in Acadia in 1683 at age 25. He was the commander of Fort de Buade in St. Ignace and founded Fort Pontchartrain du Détroit in 1701.

zh.t: 安托万·德·拉莫特·卡迪亚克在庞恰特雷恩堡建立贸易站，后来发展为底特律市
zh.s: 安托万·德·拉莫特，卡迪亚克领主（法语：[kadijak]；1658年3月5日—1730年10月16日），原名安托万·洛梅，是法国探险家、军官、新法兰西殖民地行政官，也是密歇根州底特律的创建者。他出生于加斯科涅，25岁时于1683年抵达阿卡迪亚。他曾任圣伊尼亚斯布阿德堡司令，并于1701年建立底特律庞恰特雷恩堡。

en.s: The Battle of Denain was fought on 24 July 1712 as part of the War of the Spanish Succession. It resulted in a French victory, under Marshal Villars, against Dutch and Austrian forces, under Prince Eugene of Savoy. It was the war's last battle in Flanders and one of the most consequential, breaking the Grand Alliance's ability to threaten Paris and reversing nearly two years of French territorial losses.

zh.s: 德南战役于1712年7月24日在西班牙王位继承战争期间爆发。维拉尔元帅率领的法军击败了萨伏依亲王欧根指挥的荷兰和奥地利联军。这是该战争在佛兰德斯地区的最后一场战役，也是影响最深远的战役之一，挫败了大同盟威胁巴黎的能力，并扭转了法国近两年来不断失去领土的局面。

en.s: The Chickasaw Campaign of 1739 (July 24, 1739 – March 31, 1740), also known as the Second Chickasaw War, was a continuation of the Chickasaw Wars pursued by the French in Louisiana. In 1739 the French prepared extensively but failed to engage the Chickasaw beyond some half-hearted skirmishing, and finally accepted a negotiated peace. After the 1736 disasters of Ogoula Tchetoka and Ackia, Upper and Lower Louisiana were still separated by the obstinate Chickasaw.

zh.s: 1739年奇克索战役又称第二次奇克索战争，是法国在路易斯安那地区继续对奇克索人作战的一场行动，始于1739年7月24日，持续至1740年3月31日。1739年，法军进行了大量准备，却只进行了几次不积极的小规模交战，没能与奇克索人展开大战，最终接受了谈判达成的和平协议。1736年奥古拉切托卡和阿克亚惨败后，顽强抵抗的奇克索人仍使上路易斯安那和下路易斯安那彼此隔绝。

en.s: The Conquest of New France occurred during the Seven Years' War, fought in North America between the Kingdom of Great Britain and the Kingdom of France. It started with a British campaign in 1758 and ended with the region being put under a British military regime between 1760 and 1763. Britain's acquisition of the French colony of Canada, which France had established in 1535, became official with the 1763 Treaty of Paris that concluded the Seven Years' War.

zh.s: 七年战争期间，英国王国与法国王国在北美交战，新法兰西征服战役由此展开。战役于1758年随英国军队的军事行动开始，至1760年至1763年间该地区被置于英国军事管辖之下后结束。法国于1535年建立的加拿大殖民地，最终通过结束七年战争的1763年《巴黎条约》正式归英国所有。

en.s: The Battle of La Belle-Famille occurred on July 24, 1759, during the French and Indian War along the Niagara River portage trail. François-Marie Le Marchand de Lignery's French relief force for the besieged French garrison at Fort Niagara fell into Eyre Massey's British and Haudenosaunee ambush. This action formed part of the larger Battle of Fort Niagara.

zh.s: 拉贝勒-法米耶战役于1759年7月24日在法印战争期间爆发，地点在尼亚加拉河的陆路运输道沿线。弗朗索瓦-马里·勒马尔尚·德利涅里率领一支法军援军前往被围困的尼亚加拉堡，途中遭到埃尔·马西指挥的英军和豪德诺索尼人的伏击。这次交战是更大规模的尼亚加拉堡战役的一部分。

en.s: The first siege of Scylla (Scilla) in Calabria took place from 12 to 24 July 1806 during the British expedition to Sicily to oppose the French invasion of Naples. Scylla Castle held out until 24 July when its 231-man garrison from the 23rd Light surrendered to Colonel Oswald's 2,600 soldiers. Oswald's command consisted of the 10th Foot, 21st Foot, and the Chasseurs Britanniques.

zh.s: 1806年7月12日至24日，英国远征西西里、抵抗法国入侵那不勒斯期间，英国军队首次围攻卡拉布里亚的斯基拉（Scilla）。斯基拉城堡坚持到7月24日，随后由第23轻步兵团组成的231人守军向奥斯瓦尔德上校率领的2,600名士兵投降。奥斯瓦尔德部队包括第10步兵团、第21步兵团和英国猎兵团。

en.s: The Combat of the Côa (July 24, 1810; also referred to as Coa or Cõa) was a military engagement that occurred during the Peninsular War period of the Napoleonic Wars. It took place in the valley of the Côa River and it was the first significant battle for the new army of 65,000 men controlled by Marshal André Masséna, as the French prepared for their third invasion of Portugal.

zh.s: 科阿河交战发生于1810年7月24日，是拿破仑战争期间半岛战争的一场军事交战。战斗发生在科阿河谷，是安德烈·马塞纳元帅指挥的65,000人大军迎来的首场重要战斗。当时法军正在准备第三次入侵葡萄牙。

en.s: The Battle of Lake Maracaibo also known as the "Naval Battle of the Lake" was fought on 24 July 1823 on Venezuela's Lake Maracaibo between fleets under the commands of Republican Admiral José Prudencio Padilla and royalist Captain Ángel Laborde. The engagement was won by the Republican forces, and was the last battle of the Venezuelan War of Independence and the larger Spanish American wars of independence. The Republican ships were part of the armed forces of Gran Colombia led by Simón Bolívar. The Battle of Carabobo of 1821 is usually seen in the historiography as the culminating battle for Venezuelan independence.

zh.s: 马拉开波湖海战又称“湖上之战”，于1823年7月24日在委内瑞拉马拉开波湖爆发。共和派海军上将何塞·普鲁登西奥·帕迪利亚与保王派舰长安赫尔·拉博尔德分别率领舰队交战。共和派获胜。这是委内瑞拉独立战争以及更广泛的西属美洲独立战争中的最后一场战役。共和派舰艇隶属西蒙·玻利瓦尔领导的大哥伦比亚武装力量。历史研究通常将1821年的卡拉沃沃战役视为委内瑞拉独立的决定性战役。

en.s: The Battle of Milazzo was fought between 17 and 24 July 1860 in the vicinity and in the city of Milazzo, when the Thousand led by Giuseppe Garibaldi, together with numerous volunteers who subsequently landed, mainly the Medici, formed the first nucleus of the Southern Army, that is, Garibaldi's army that landed in Sicily, invading the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies. They defeated the Bourbon soldiers.

zh.s: 米拉佐战役于1860年7月17日至24日在米拉佐城及其周边地区进行。朱塞佩·加里波第率领“千人军”在许多志愿者（主要是梅迪奇部）陆续登陆支援后，组建了南方军的首批主力部队，即登陆西西里岛、入侵两西西里王国的加里波第军。加里波第军击败了波旁王朝的士兵。

en.s: The Battle of Big Mound was a United States Army victory in July 1863 over the Santee Sioux Indians allied with some Yankton, Yanktonai and Teton Sioux in Dakota Territory.

en.s: The Gettysburg campaign was a military invasion of Pennsylvania by the main Confederate army under General Robert E. Lee in summer 1863. It was the first time during the war the Confederate Army attempted a full-scale invasion of a free state. The Union won a decisive victory at Gettysburg, July 1–3, with heavy casualties on both sides. Lee managed to escape back to Virginia with most of his army.

zh.s: 1863年夏，由罗伯特·E·李将军率领的邦联主力军入侵宾夕法尼亚州，发动葛底斯堡战役。这是战争期间邦联军首次试图大规模入侵一个自由州。联邦军于7月1日至3日在葛底斯堡取得决定性胜利，双方伤亡惨重。李设法率领大部分军队撤回弗吉尼亚。

en.s: The Second Battle of Kernstown was fought on July 24, 1864, at Kernstown, Virginia, outside Winchester, Virginia, as part of the Valley Campaigns of 1864 in the American Civil War. The confederate Army of the Valley under Lt. Gen. Jubal A. Early soundly defeated the Union Army of West Virginia under Brig. Gen. George Crook and drove it from the Shenandoah Valley back over the Potomac River into Maryland. As a result, Early was able to launch the Confederacy's last major raid into northern territory, attacking the Baltimore and Ohio Railroad in Maryland and West Virginia and burning Chambersburg, Pennsylvania, in retaliation for the burning of some civilian houses and farms earlier in the campaign.

zh.s: 第二次克恩斯敦战役于1864年7月24日在弗吉尼亚州温彻斯特郊外的克恩斯敦爆发，是美国内战期间1864年谢南多厄河谷战役的一部分。朱巴尔·A·厄利中将率领的邦联军谷地军大败乔治·克鲁克准将率领的联邦西弗吉尼亚军，将其赶出谢南多厄河谷，越过波托马克河退入马里兰州。此后，厄利得以发动邦联军最后一次大规模北方袭击，攻击马里兰州和西弗吉尼亚州的巴尔的摩与俄亥俄铁路，并焚毁宾夕法尼亚州钱伯斯堡，以报复此前战役中部分民房和农场被烧毁。

en.s: The Battle of Werbach took place during the Austro-Prussian War as part of the Campaign of the Main on 24 July 1866 between the Prussian Alliance and the German Federal Army.

zh.s: 韦尔巴赫战役于1866年7月24日爆发，是普奥战争美因河战役的一部分，交战双方是普鲁士联盟和德意志邦联军队。

en.s: The Battle of Tauberbischofsheim was an engagement of the Austro-Prussian War of 1866, on the 24 July at Tauberbischofsheim in the Grand Duchy of Baden between troops of the German Confederation and the Kingdom of Prussia. It was part of the campaign of the Main and ended with a Prussian victory.

zh.s: 陶伯比绍夫斯海姆战役于1866年7月24日在巴登大公国陶伯比绍夫斯海姆爆发，是普奥战争美因河战役的一场交战。交战双方是德意志邦联军队和普鲁士王国军队。战斗以普鲁士获胜告终。

en.s: The Passage of Fortín Island consisted of the transposition carried out by a naval division of the Imperial Brazilian Navy - consisting of the ironclads Bahia and Silvado, and the monitor Alagoas - against a Paraguayan fortified position located near the Fortress of Humaitá called Fortín Island, on the banks of the Paraguay River, on 24 July 1868, during the Paraguayan War.

zh.s: 巴拉圭战争期间，1868年7月24日，巴西帝国海军一支分舰队强行通过福廷岛附近的巴拉圭防御阵地。该阵地位于巴拉圭河畔、胡迈塔要塞附近。巴西舰队由铁甲舰“巴伊亚”号和“西尔瓦多”号，以及浅水重炮舰“阿拉戈斯”号组成。

en.s: The City of Auckland by-election of 1895 was a by-election held on 24 July 1895 during the 12th New Zealand Parliament in the urban seat of the City of Auckland. The contest was won by Thomas Thompson of the Liberal Party. Thompson convincingly beat the conservative candidate Richard Monk recording nearly a two thousand vote majority.

zh.s: 1895年7月24日，新西兰第十二届议会期间，奥克兰市城市选区举行补选。自由党候选人托马斯·汤普森获胜，大幅领先保守党候选人理查德·蒙克，领先票数接近2,000票。

en.s: The 1895 New South Wales colonial election was held on 24 July 1895 for all of the 125 seats in the seventeenth New South Wales Legislative Assembly. The election was conducted in single-member constituencies with a first-past-the-post voting system. Section 23 (1) of the Parliamentary Electorates and Elections Act of 1893 conferred a right to vote on 'every male person, being a natural born [British] subject, who shall have resided or had his principal place of abode in New South Wales for a continuous period of one year'.

zh.s: 新南威尔士于1895年7月24日举行殖民地选举，改选第十七届新南威尔士立法议会的全部125个席位。选举采用单一选区制和简单多数制。根据1893年《议会选区与选举法》第23条第1款，所有自然出生的英国臣民（男性），只要在新南威尔士连续居住或以该地为主要住所满一年，均有投票权。

en.s: The Bodmin by-election, 1906 was a by-election held on 24 July 1906 for the British House of Commons constituency of Bodmin in Cornwall. The by-election was triggered by the unseating of the town's Liberal Member of Parliament (MP) Thomas Agar-Robartes, as a result of an election petition alleging illegal payments to potential voters. The success of the petition was controversial, as the presiding Judge, Justice Grantham, himself a former Conservative MP, was already facing criticism for a decision on an election petition in the Great Yarmouth constituency which had been considered unduly favourable to the Conservatives.

zh.s: 1906年7月24日，英国下议院康沃尔郡博德明选区举行补选。此前，该选区自由党议员托马斯·阿加-罗伯特斯因一份选举请愿书指控其向潜在选民非法付款而被取消议员资格，因此举行补选。请愿获准一事颇具争议：主审法官格兰瑟姆本人曾是保守党议员，且此前他处理大雅茅斯选区选举请愿案时，已因被认为过分偏袒保守党而受到批评。

en.s: The Young Turk Revolution (July 1908; Turkish: Jön Türk Devrimi) was a constitutionalist revolution in the Ottoman Empire. Revolutionaries belonging to the Internal Committee of Union and Progress (CUP), an organization of the Young Turks movement, forced Sultan Abdul Hamid II to restore the Constitution, recall the parliament, and schedule an election.

zh.s: 青年土耳其党革命（土耳其语：Jön Türk Devrimi）发生于1908年7月，是奥斯曼帝国的一场立宪革命。属于青年土耳其运动的统一进步委员会内部委员会的革命者迫使苏丹阿卜杜勒-哈米德二世恢复宪法、召回议会并安排选举。

en.s: The Albanian revolt of 1910 was a reaction to the new centralization policies of the Young Turk Ottoman government in Albania. It was the first of a series of major uprisings. Rebels were supported by the Kingdom of Serbia. New taxes levied in the early months of 1910 led to Isa Boletini's activity to convince Albanian leaders who had already been involved in a 1909 uprising to try another revolt against the Ottoman Empire.
en.n: The Ottoman Empire captures the city of Shkodër, putting down the Albanian Revolt of 1910.

zh.s: 1910年阿尔巴尼亚起义是对青年土耳其党奥斯曼政府在阿尔巴尼亚推行新中央集权政策的反抗。这是随后一系列重大起义中的第一次，起义者得到塞尔维亚王国支持。1910年初开征的新税促使伊萨·博莱蒂尼出面劝说曾参与1909年起义的阿尔巴尼亚领导人再次反抗奥斯曼帝国。
zh.n: 奥斯曼帝国攻占斯库台，镇压1910年阿尔巴尼亚起义。

en.s: The Grey by-election of 1913 was a by-election held for Grey during the 18th New Zealand Parliament. As no candidate won an absolute majority on the first ballot on 17 July, a second round was held on 24 July. The seat had become vacant due to the death of Arthur Guinness. Three candidates contested the seat, and it was won by the left-wing candidate, who was elected on the second ballot with Liberal support.

zh.s: 新西兰第18届议会期间，格雷选区于1913年举行补选。7月17日的首轮投票中，没有候选人获得绝对多数，因此7月24日举行第二轮投票。此前，议席因亚瑟·吉尼斯去世而出缺。共有三名候选人参选，左翼候选人在自由党支持下于第二轮投票中获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Krechowce (Polish: Bitwa pod Krechowcami) took place on 24 July 1917, during World War I. Polish uhlans of the Russian Army were ordered to halt Imperial German Army forces advancing on the city of Stanisławów, located in Galicia in Austria-Hungary. The battle between the Polish and German forces took place near the village of Krechowce (Ukrainian: Крихівці).

zh.s: 克雷霍夫采战役（波兰语：Bitwa pod Krechowcami）于1917年7月24日第一次世界大战期间爆发。俄军中的波兰枪骑兵奉命阻止正向加利西亚奥匈帝国境内的斯坦尼斯瓦乌夫推进的德意志帝国军队。波兰军与德军在克雷霍夫采村附近交战（乌克兰语：Крихівці）。

en.s: The 1919 Prince Edward Island general election was held in the Canadian province of Prince Edward Island on July 24, 1919. The opposition Liberals led by John Howatt Bell gained eleven seats to defeat the incumbent government of Conservative Premier Aubin E. Arsenault, who had succeeded former Premier John A. Mathieson in 1917. John A. Dewar, a former Conservative member, was elected as an Independent Assemblyman for 3rd Kings.

zh.s: 加拿大爱德华王子岛省于1919年7月24日举行大选。约翰·霍沃特·贝尔领导的反对党自由党赢得11个席位，击败在任保守党政府。保守党省长奥宾·E·阿森诺于1917年接替前省长约翰·A·马西森。保守党前议员约翰·A·德瓦当选为金斯第三区选区的无党派议员。

en.s: The Battle of Maysalun (Arabic: معركة ميسلون), also known as the Battle of Maysalun Pass or the Battle of Khan Maysalun (French: Bataille de Khan Mayssaloun), was a four-hour battle fought between the forces of the Arab Kingdom of Syria and the French Army of the Levant on 24 July 1920 near Maysalun in the Anti-Lebanon Mountains, about 25 kilometres (16 mi) west of Damascus.

zh.s: 迈萨隆战役（阿拉伯语：معركة ميسلون）又称迈萨隆山口战役或汗迈萨隆战役（法语：Bataille de Khan Mayssaloun），于1920年7月24日在叙利亚王国军队与法国黎凡特军团之间进行，持续四小时。战斗发生在反黎巴嫩山脉的迈萨隆附近，距离大马士革以西约25公里。

en.s: The 1920 capture of Damascus was the final stage of the Franco-Syrian War in which French forces captured Damascus with little resistance. The Arab Kingdom of Syria was brought to an end, and the French mandate of Syria was put into effect. Shortly afterward, in September 1920, Damascus was established as the capital of the State of Damascus under a French mandate.

zh.s: 1920年，法国军队几乎未遇抵抗便攻占大马士革，结束了法叙战争。叙利亚阿拉伯王国随之灭亡，法国对叙利亚的委任统治开始实施。随后，1920年9月，大马士革成为法国委任统治下大马士革国的首都。

en.s: The Treaty of Lausanne (French: Traité de Lausanne; Turkish: Lozan Antlaşması) is a peace treaty negotiated during the Lausanne Conference of 1922–1923 and signed in the Palais de Rumine in Lausanne, Switzerland, on 24 July 1923. The treaty officially resolved the conflict that had initially arisen between the Ottoman Empire and the Allied French Republic, British Empire, Kingdom of Italy, Empire of Japan, Kingdom of Greece, Kingdom of Yugoslavia, and the Kingdom of Romania since the outset of World War I. The original text of the treaty is in English and French.

zh.s: 《洛桑条约》（法语：Traité de Lausanne；土耳其语：Lozan Antlaşması）是在1922年至1923年洛桑会议期间谈判达成的和平条约，于1923年7月24日在瑞士洛桑的鲁米纳宫签署。条约正式解决了自第一次世界大战爆发以来奥斯曼帝国与协约国之间的冲突。协约国包括法兰西共和国、大英帝国、意大利王国、日本帝国、希腊王国、南斯拉夫王国和罗马尼亚王国。条约原文以英语和法语写成。

en.s: The 1923 Prince Edward Island general election was held in the Canadian province of Prince Edward Island on July 24, 1923. The opposition Conservatives led by James D. Stewart gained many seats to defeat the incumbent government of Liberal Premier John Howatt Bell. This election had a number of firsts for PEI. It was the first election in which women on the Island could vote, following legislation passed in 1921.

zh.s: 加拿大爱德华王子岛省于1923年7月24日举行大选。詹姆斯·D·斯图尔特领导的反对党保守党赢得多个席位，击败了在任自由党省长约翰·霍沃特·贝尔领导的政府。这次选举在爱德华王子岛历史上开创了多项先例：根据1921年通过的法律，岛上女性首次获得投票权。

en.s: The Kellogg–Briand Pact or Pact of Paris (officially the General Treaty for Renunciation of War as an Instrument of National Policy) is a 1928 international agreement on peace in which signatory states promised not to use war to resolve "disputes or conflicts of whatever nature or of whatever origin they may be, which may arise among them".

zh.s: 《凯洛格-白里安条约》又称《巴黎公约》，正式名称为《放弃以战争作为国家政策工具总条约》。这是一项于1928年缔结的国际和平协定，签署国承诺，不以战争解决彼此之间“可能产生的任何性质或任何起因的争端或冲突”。

en.s: The XYZ Line (Spanish: Línea XYZ), also known as the Matallana Line, was a system of fortifications built in 1938 during the Spanish Civil War to defend Valencia, the capital of the Second Spanish Republic. The XYZ Line was a simple system of trenches and bunkers, built to withstand heavy artillery or 450-kilogram (992 lb) aerial bombs, and took advantage of some of the most difficult terrain in Spain in the Iberian System ranges to the north and northeast of Valencia.

en.s: The Battle of Kautla (Estonian: Kautla lahing, Kautla veresaun or Kautla veretöö) was a battle between Soviet destruction battalions and Estonian Forest Brothers in Kautla, Estonia in July 1941. It included series of murders of civilians committed by destruction battalions, known as Kautla massacre. On 24 July 1941, an extermination battalion murdered Gustav and Rosalie Viljamaa of Simisalu farm and set the farm on fire. In the coming days, the extermination battalion undertook the systematic murder of all civilians in the region and burning their farms.

zh.s: 考特拉战役是苏联毁灭营与爱沙尼亚“森林兄弟”于1941年7月在爱沙尼亚考特拉发生的一场战斗。战斗期间，苏联毁灭营杀害平民，这些杀戮被称为考特拉大屠杀。1941年7月24日，一支毁灭营杀害了西米萨卢农场的古斯塔夫和罗莎莉·维尔亚马，并放火烧毁农场。此后几天，毁灭营系统地杀害当地所有平民，并烧毁他们的农场。

en.s: The Battle of Voronezh, or First Battle of Voronezh, was a battle on the Eastern Front of World War II, fought in and around the strategically important city of Voronezh on the Don river, 450 km (280 mi) south of Moscow, from 28 June to 24 July 1942, as the opening move of the German summer offensive in 1942.

zh.s: 沃罗涅日战役又称第一次沃罗涅日战役，是第二次世界大战东线战场的一场战役，于1942年6月28日至7月24日在顿河畔战略要地沃罗涅日市及周边地区进行。该市位于莫斯科以南450公里。这场战役是德军1942年夏季攻势的开端。

en.s: Operation Bulbasket was an operation undertaken by 'B' Squadron, 1st Special Air Service (SAS), behind enemy lines in German occupied France, between June and August 1944. The operation took place to the east of Poitiers in the Vienne department of south west France. en.s: The Santiago de Compostela derailment occurred on 24 July 2013, when an Alvia high-speed train travelling from Madrid to Ferrol, in the north-west of Spain, derailed at high speed on a bend about 4 kilometres (2.5 mi) outside of the railway station at Santiago de Compostela, Spain. Of the 222 people (218 passengers and 4 crew) aboard, around 140 were injured and 79 died. The train's data recorder showed that it was travelling at about twice the posted speed limit of 80 kilometres per hour (50 mph) when it entered a bend in the line.

zh.t: 圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉列车脱轨事故
zh.s: 圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉列车脱轨事故发生于2013年7月24日。一列从马德里开往西班牙西北部费罗尔的阿尔维亚高速列车，在圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉火车站外约4公里处高速驶过弯道时脱轨。车上222人（218名乘客和4名机组人员）中约140人受伤、79人死亡。列车数据记录仪显示，列车进入弯道时的速度约为每小时160公里，是该路段每小时80公里限速的两倍。

en.s: The Uli Hoeneß Cup was a pre-season association football match that took place on 24 July 2013 at the Allianz Arena in Munich, Germany. The competition featured hosts and 2012–13 UEFA Champions League winner Bayern Munich and the 2012–13 Spanish champions Barcelona. The game was the first that Bayern Munich's new manager Pep Guardiola contested against his former club Barcelona and was a late 60th birthday present for Bayern Munich club president Uli Hoeneß. The entire proceeds were donated towards social purposes. The original planned kick-off time (20:30) was changed because of the 2013 UEFA Women's Championship semi-final match between Sweden and Germany.

zh.s: 乌利·赫内斯杯是一场季前足球友谊赛，于2013年7月24日在德国慕尼黑安联球场举行。参赛球队是东道主、2012—13赛季欧洲冠军联赛冠军拜仁慕尼黑，以及2012—13赛季西班牙联赛冠军巴塞罗那。这是拜仁新任主教练佩普·瓜迪奥拉首次率队对阵老东家巴塞罗那。比赛也是拜仁俱乐部主席乌利·赫内斯迟来的60岁生日礼物。比赛的全部收入都捐作社会公益用途。原定于20时30分开球，因2013年欧洲女子足球锦标赛瑞典对德国的半决赛而调整了开球时间。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Terengganu State Assembly seat of Kuala Besut on 24 July 2013 with nomination day on 12 July 2013. The seat of Kuala Besut fell vacant after the death of incumbent assemblyman, A. Rahman Mokhtar on 26 June 2013 from lung cancer. Dr. Mokhtar was an assemblyman from the United Malays National Organisation, a component party of the ruling Barisan Nasional coalition, which holds a 1-seat majority into the by-election.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Iraq on 24 July 2014 to elect the President of Iraq for a four-year term via indirect suffrage by the Council of Representatives. The result was a win for Fuad Masum, who received 211 votes. The position is largely ceremonial, with Iraq being a parliamentary system.

zh.s: 伊拉克于2014年7月24日举行总统选举，由伊拉克国民议会间接选举任期四年的总统。福阿德·马苏姆以211票获胜。伊拉克实行议会制，总统职位主要具有礼仪性质。

en.s: Air Algérie Flight 5017 was a scheduled international passenger flight from Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso, to Algiers, Algeria, which crashed near Gossi, Mali, on 24 July 2014. The McDonnell Douglas MD-83 twinjet, operated by Spanish charter airline Swiftair for Air Algérie, disappeared from radar about fifty minutes after take-off. All 110 passengers and 6 crew members on board died.

zh.t: 阿尔及利亚航空5017号班机空难
zh.s: 阿尔及利亚航空5017号班机是一趟定期国际客运航班，从布基纳法索瓦加杜古飞往阿尔及利亚阿尔及尔，于2014年7月24日在马里戈西附近坠毁。由西班牙包机航空公司Swiftair为阿尔及利亚航空执飞的麦克唐纳·道格拉斯MD-83双发喷气式客机，在起飞约50分钟后从雷达上消失。机上110名乘客和6名机组人员全部遇难。

en.s: Battleground (also known as Battlefield in Germany) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event and WWE Network event produced by WWE. It took place on July 24, 2016 at the Verizon Center in Washington, D.C. It was the fourth event under the Battleground chronology, and the final event before the newly reinstated WWE brand extension went into full effect. Nine matches were contested at the event, with one match contested on the pre-show. In the main event, Dean Ambrose successfully retained the WWE Championship in a triple threat match against his former Shield teammates, Seth Rollins and Roman Reigns, thus keeping the championship at the SmackDown brand.

zh.s: 《战场》（在德国又称《战地》）是WWE制作的职业摔角按次付费和WWE Network直播赛事，于2016年7月24日在华盛顿特区的威瑞森中心举行。这是《战场》系列的第四届赛事，也是WWE恢复品牌分拆正式实施前的最后一场赛事。比赛共九场，其中一场在开赛前秀中进行。主赛中，迪恩·安布罗斯在三重威胁赛中击败昔日盾牌队友塞斯·罗林斯和罗曼·雷恩斯，成功卫冕WWE冠军，使冠军头衔留在SmackDown品牌。

en.t: Boris Johnson becomes Prime Minister of the United Kingdom after defeating Jeremy Hunt in a leadership contest, succeeding Theresa May
en.s: Alexander Boris de Pfeffel Johnson (born 19 June 1964) is a British politician and writer who was Prime Minister of the United Kingdom and Leader of the Conservative Party from 2019 to 2022. He was previously Foreign Secretary from 2016 to 2018 and Mayor of London from 2008 to 2016. He was Member of Parliament (MP) for Henley from 2001 to 2008 and for Uxbridge and South Ruislip from 2015 to 2023.

zh.t: 鲍里斯·约翰逊在党魁选举中击败杰里米·亨特，接替特蕾莎·梅成为英国首相
zh.s: 亚历山大·鲍里斯·德·普费费尔·约翰逊（1964年6月19日出生）是英国政治人物和作家，2019年至2022年担任英国首相和保守党领袖。他此前于2016年至2018年担任外交大臣，2008年至2016年担任伦敦市长。2001年至2008年，他是亨利选区议员；2015年至2023年，他代表乌克斯桥和南赖斯利普选区。

en.s: On 24 July 2024, a Bombardier CRJ200 operated by Saurya Airlines crashed shortly after takeoff from Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu, Nepal, killing 18 out of the 19 people on board. The aircraft was operating a ferry flight to Pokhara to conduct a maintenance check and was carrying three crew members and sixteen passengers, mostly consisting of Saurya employees. During takeoff, the aircraft rapidly rolled both left and right before losing altitude. The right wing collided with the ground to the side of the runway and the aircraft was destroyed by the impact and post-crash fire.

zh.t: 2024年索尔亚航空庞巴迪CRJ200坠机事故
zh.s: 2024年7月24日，索尔亚航空一架庞巴迪CRJ200客机从尼泊尔加德满都特里布万国际机场起飞后不久坠毁，机上19人中有18人死亡。飞机当时正执行调机任务，准备飞往博卡拉进行维修检查；机上有3名机组人员和16名乘客，其中大多是索尔亚航空员工。起飞过程中，飞机迅速左右倾斜，随后失去高度。飞机右侧机翼撞上跑道旁地面，机身因撞击和坠机后的火灾而毁损。

en.s: The 2024 Major League Soccer All-Star Game was the 28th annual Major League Soccer All-Star Game, an exhibition soccer match in the United States. It featured all-star squads from Major League Soccer (MLS) and Liga MX of Mexico—the third edition to use the inter-league format. en.s: Angara Airlines Flight 2311 was a scheduled domestic flight from Ignatyevo Airport to Tynda Airport, operated by Angara Airlines. On 24 July 2025, an Antonov An-24 operating that flight crashed in Amur Oblast, Russia during its second landing attempt in poor visibility. The crashed site is about 16 kilometres (10 miles) from Tynda airport into a forest near Tynda in eastern Russia.

zh.t: 安加拉航空2311号班机空难
zh.s: 安加拉航空2311号班机是一趟从伊格纳季耶沃机场飞往滕达机场的国内定期航班。2025年7月24日，安加拉航空一架安-24客机在能见度不佳的情况下第二次尝试降落时，于俄罗斯阿穆尔州坠毁。坠机地点位于距滕达机场约16公里、靠近滕达镇的森林中，靠近滕达。
